manifest.method: For each named tokenizer, delta = len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) per fixed pair; per-model value is the mean over eight pairs. Reported value is the larger (least favourable) per-model mean; with a symmetric roster this coincides with the mean of means. value_lo/value_hi = min/max per-pair delta on the floor tokenizer. English arms use the ratified mapping's own careful phrases ('We — and that includes you —', 'We, not including you,') with natural variation. Local deterministic count: tiktoken 0.13.0.
